en.title: Longest Common Prefix Length of Numbers from Two Arrays
en.description:
Given two arrays of positive integers, take one number from each and find the maximum, over all pairs, of the length of the longest common prefix of their decimal representations; if no pair shares a first digit, output 0.

Standard input/output and this site's supplementary ranges follow this problem's description.
en.input: The first line contains n m (1≤n,m≤50000), followed by two lines giving n and m integers respectively, all in [1,10⁹]. The range of m is a site supplement, following the original limit given for the first array.
en.output: Output the maximum length of the longest common prefix, as one integer.
en.explanation: Insert all decimal prefixes of the second array into a Trie. Query each number of the first array, walking down the Trie as far as possible; the maximum depth reached is the answer.
